results.title: Impact of Import Tariffs on Exports and Global Supply Chain
results.content:
A tariff is a government-imposed fee on imported goods, designed to regulate trade & protect domestic industries. However, in today’s global market, tariffs also play an important role in encouraging sustainable trade, pushing businesses to adopt green logistics strategies & easy supply chains that minimise environmental impact while maintaining trade compliance with international standards. There are two forms of tariff: the ad valorem tariff, which is paid as a fraction of import value, and [...] When a country imposes import tariffs, the importer may pass these added costs onto the exporter. For instance, if an importing nation sets tariffs on aviation equipment, the exporter may struggle to meet competitive pricing. This can lead to a decreased market for the goods they are exporting.

## Disruption in Supply Chains [...] Tariffs play an important role in global trade, affecting both imports and exports. It’s important for businesses, especially in industries like aviation, healthcare, IT, and automotive, to understand how tariffs work. Tariffs often mean higher costs, disruptions in supply chains, and sometimes lower product quality. Tariffs can also make goods more expensive for buyers in other countries. These trade barriers force exporting countries and companies to rethink their shipping strategies,
